findings.text: the parity net selects stub cases by tmp_path presence, so a future pointer-bearing stub whose signature lacks that fixture is silently excluded; today's population is complete at 12 definitions with 10 selected, but no assertion ties the selection to the pointer-bearing set.

item_verdicts.diff: The diff extracts _watch_verdict from the former inline derivation, publishes it as fleet_verdict beside the lifecycle vocabulary, and makes both emitters consume it without another evidence probe.
item_verdicts.done_when: All four delivered clauses hold — the driver test emits running/working for a supervisor-exited live worker with commits, the parity net selects every pointer-bearing stub in tests/test_a_live_run_never_reads_dead.py, the declared negative control reddens at the live-worker assertion, and the gate reports zero added failures over base.
item_verdicts.goal: The watcher snapshot and transition emission now take each run's liveness and fleet classification from classify_pointer's published fleet_verdict, and no production path derives that verdict a second time.
item_verdicts.manifest: The manifest's numbers reconcile with its logs — 12 new tests, 191 passed against 179 at base, the same eight failure ids in both arms, and a negative control whose first line repeats the declared mutation verbatim.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The two commits touch exactly the five fenced paths, every documentation delta is purely additive, and the plan's lifecycle metadata and driving followup are untouched.

justifications.durability: Durable writes held — the code was committed at 15:10 before the documentation commit at 15:13, the manifest was written before long output and repaired afterwards, and no content line outside recovery.py was deleted; withheld because the gate arm lags the reviewed head by one commit and the coverage claim rests on a discovery filter that would silently exclude a future stub lacking tmp_path.
justifications.evidence: Independently rechecked at the reviewed head — 12 of 12 tests pass, 12 test definitions enumerate to 10 selected pointer-bearing stubs with both exclusions non-pointer, the control reddens at the declared assertion, and both gate arms carry the same eight failure ids; withheld because the gate ran at the code commit 7bcd27ac rather than the reviewed docs head db0f4237, and because the parity assertions compare two consumers of one output, leaving their independence to the refuse-armed test and the control.
justifications.fit: The change removes a second derivation of one fact, which is the plan's stated aim, keeps the lifecycle vocabulary for existing callers, and adds fleet attention as a new key; withheld one point because the row that was flat of scalars now carries a nested mapping that consumers iterating row values must tolerate.
justifications.goal_fidelity: Delivered as the aim states — one derivation consumed by both emitters, with the honest caveat that the recorded live-worker symptom did not reproduce at this base, so the verified claim is the structural sharing and the parity net's population is selected by a signature heuristic rather than asserted equal to the pointer-bearing set.
justifications.scope_discipline: Both commits touch exactly the five fenced paths, with the documentation deltas purely additive, the plan lifecycle metadata untouched, and no plan, ticket or attribution text in any message.
